plan.sample_size_status: Fixed 400 evaluation products; precision-driven, not a formal 80%-power claim. Existing ATLAS B combined-v-confidence 50% interval half-width ~0.0765 at n=169 scales to ~0.0497 at n=400 under similar variability. This is a planning approximation; actual intervals may be wider.

primary_comparison.criterion: two-sided paired product-bootstrap 95% CI entirely below zero

plan.original_protocol_changes: none; new study must use its own protocol and output directory
requirements_before_generation: Fix primary comparison and coverage, supporting comparisons and multiplicity policy
Document candidate data overlap and historical-release limitations
Justify cohort size against achievable precision
Check authenticated model availability and current provider charges
Reserve a conservative monetary bound before every request, including possible failures
Freeze protocol before inspecting new evaluation outputs
plan.secondary_comparisons: All four policies, both designations, 30/50/70% coverage, wrong-chapter rates and full curves; descriptive pointwise intervals, no extra confirmatory claims
plan.development_use: 200 products for calibration and technical diagnostics only; no policy/model/coverage selection after evaluation starts
plan.outcome_integrity: New evaluation model outputs not seen before this freeze; original tests informed design and are not reused as confirmation
plan.decoding_change: New study caps both models at 4000 output tokens instead of original 8000; failed/truncated predictions retained as failures, no retrospective cap changes
plan.budget_accounting: Every attempt reserves EUR 0.075 permanently, including malformed retries and failures. Shared ledger across prospective stages. 1200 base calls reserve EUR 90; 1320 attempts reserve EUR 99. No refunds based on estimated actual usage.
plan.price_bound_basis: Text only, no tools or caching writes. Prompt UTF8 bytes <=2048; input budget 4096 tokens including ample framing allowance. Output <=4000 tokens including reasoning. At max USD2/M input and USD10/M output, <=USD0.048192 per call; multiplying by 1.5 EUR per USD for FX/fees/tax contingency gives EUR0.072288, rounded up to EUR0.075. Factor is a conservative accounting allowance, not a quoted exchange rate.
plan.candidate_data_status: Public ATLAS training split, heuristic deduplication only; no claim of absent model-training exposure or complete ruling independence; all 400 evaluations retained regardless of gold schedule membership
